dateline: Mexico City — ARIRANG Tour Night 3 Grand Finale at Estadio GNP Seguros; BTS Attend Lucha Libre at Arena México
heroHeadline: Day 4,714: BTS Mexico City Grand Finale — Night 3 Closes Three-Night ARIRANG Tour Run; Jin and Members at Arena México
heroSubtitle: May 10, 2026 is Day 4,714 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS performs Night 3 — the grand finale — of their historic three-night Mexico City run at Estadio GNP Seguros, completing a 136,000+ fan run that is the largest-scale K-pop stadium event in Latin American history. RM delivers a farewell address in Spanish and 'Spring Day' premieres on the ARIRANG World Tour to thunderous response. V's closing 'México, los llevamos en el corazón para siempre' goes viral within minutes. Separately, Jin and BTS members attend a lucha libre event at Arena México, where pro-wrestler Místico wears a BTS-embroidered jacket in tribute — a cross-cultural moment that resonates deeply with ARMY in Latin America. Billboard describes the GNP Seguros run as 'the defining K-pop event of 2026.' With Mexico City now complete, the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Las Vegas (Allegiant Stadium, May 23–28). 'SWIM' heads into its 8th consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100 and ARIRANG into its 8th straight week in the Billboard 200 Top 5 — both all-time K-pop records.
